evidence_basis: Fucke 2008 thesis (Heidelberg, MPIMF; accepted 2007-10-17): read in full text from the repository PDF, converted with pdftotext -layout. Read: abstract; Methods 2.1.1 (slice preparation, patch-clamp setup, solutions, drugs) and 2.1.2 data analysis; Results 2.2.2 (Rin and cAR definitions, age table), 2.2.4 (all pharmacology: phenytoin, TTX, ZD7288, BaCl2, spermine) and the BaCl2 / HH-fit conductance section; Discussion 2.3.2 (KIR channels); Chapter 3 simulated-pharmacology paragraph; Introduction lines about Hwa and Avoli 1991. Not read: Introduction otherwise, Results 2.2.1 (morphology) and 2.2.3 (suprathreshold), Discussion 2.3.1 and later, Chapter 3 modelling methods, chapters 4 onward, figures as images (captions only; the Ba2+ numbers used are in the text).
The age label p14 is a group label; the spread of ages inside the group is not stated in the text read (full text searched for p13, p15, p16, p17 and 'days old' without a hit).
